caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate iron gate with a pointed arch at the top, rendered in shades of black and gray on a plain, light-colored background. The gate features intricate scrollwork, floral motifs, and symmetrical patterns throughout its structure. There are vertical bars on each side, adorned with pointed finials that resemble spearheads. The central section of the gate is filled with elaborate curvilinear and leafy designs, with additional decorative elements forming a crest at the peak of the arch. The joints and hinges of the gate are visible on the right side. The lower right corner of the drawing bears the name "Albert Levone" in small, uppercase letters. The surrounding area is blank except for some faint, sketchy outlines indicating the gate’s positioning within a wall or frame.
title: Cast Iron Gate
